scope: Completed CPU-only expansion cases 21 through 28; manually inspected scanner RGB H&E, virtual DAPI, DAPI/StarDist overlay, CK and CD68 contact sheets

reviewed_cases.visual_observation: The dense prostate field shows many bright virtual-DAPI structures near H&E nuclei, but the signal is broad and the fixed nuclear-boundary contrast is 0.041. It may be informative for an independently defined QC calibration, not a retrospective pass.
Dense breast nuclei are visible in H&E; virtual DAPI follows the cell-rich region but lacks sharp nuclear localization at many StarDist outlines. Boundary contrast is 0.032.
Several sparse prostate nuclei are bright, while others have weak or displaced virtual-DAPI signal. AUC 0.671 is below the fixed gate.
In a sparse breast field, virtual-DAPI blobs extend well beyond several outlined nuclei and merge along tissue borders. AUC and boundary contrast fail.
The blood-rich prostate field contains many non-nucleated erythrocytes. Virtual DAPI is bright in some non-nuclear areas and misses several outlined nuclei.
This erythrocyte-rich breast field has prominent dark H&E nuclei that remain dark in virtual DAPI, while several non-nuclear red-cell regions are bright. AUC is near chance at 0.510.

Many prostate nuclei are bright in the virtual-DAPI panel, but several bright regions join adjacent cells and the fixed boundary contrast is 0.040. It is a candidate for independent QC calibration only.
Virtual DAPI highlights some nuclei in a sparse breast field, but there are broad cytoplasmic/tissue-edge signals and inconsistent agreement with StarDist outlines. Boundary contrast is 0.026.

limits: All eight fail the frozen automated QC and remain excluded. Only DAPI, CK and CD68 spatial channels are shown in these contact sheets; complete 23-channel visual inspection would be required before inclusion. Border-shadow or seam metrics alone cannot establish marker accuracy.
